old: Its name comes from what it was thought to do with its mouth.
The word literally means "biter," built from an old verb plus a small suffix.
It shares a root with Danish bille and Old High German bicco, all pointing back to the act of biting.
clues: This kind of insect has a name that literally means "the biter," built from an old word for a creature that tends to bite.
More specific than just any bug, it is an insect whose front wings have hardened into a glossy shell. Ladybugs, scarabs, fireflies and weevils all belong to this huge group.
Volkswagen's classic rounded little car carries this name, and a famous Liverpool band borrowed it, with a musical twist, when naming themselves.
